test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 06
subject: general
question: The Bihar Civil Courts Bill, 2026 replaces which colonial-era legislation?

options.text: Bengal, Agra and Assam Civil Courts Act, 1887

solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengal, Agra and Assam Civil Courts Act, 1887.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Bihar Legislative Assembly passed the Bihar Civil Courts Bill, 2026 replacing the British-era Bengal, Agra and Assam Civil Courts Act, 1887.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The new law establishes a Bihar-specific civil court framework.**
 
• **It replaces a 139-year-old colonial legislation.**
 
• **Lower court judges will be appointed in consultation with the Patna High Court.**
 
• **The reform modernises the state’s judicial administrative structure.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Voice Vote:** A legislative voting method where members express approval or disapproval orally.
 
• **Colonial-Era Laws:** Laws enacted during British rule that continue unless repealed or replaced.
